title: N-able patches 17 more N-central flaws as attackers exploit the platform and deploy crypto miners
what_changed: Plain and exec said attackers used previously unknown flaws and exploited up-to-date servers. The Hacker News ties the miners to 4EverAble2Shell (disclosed earlier, Legacy API enabled) and says PoCs for new flaws work against Hotfix 2; it does not say the 17 patched flaws were exploited. Wording and title narrowed.
